n, m = map(int, input().split())
if n > m:
    n, m = m, n
sizeN = 1 << n
dp = [[1000000000 for _ in range(sizeN)] for _ in range(sizeN)]
for i in range(sizeN):
    dp[0][i] = 0
for step in range(m):
    newDp = [[1000000000 for _ in range(sizeN)] for _ in range(sizeN)]
    for prevC0 in range(sizeN):
        for prevC1 in range(sizeN):
            if dp[prevC0][prevC1] != 1000000000:
                limitC2 = 1 if step == m - 1 else sizeN
                for c2 in range(limitC2):
                    allBits = sizeN - 1
                    doneBits = ((allBits & (prevC1 >> 1)) | (allBits & (prevC1 << 1)) | prevC0 | c2)
                    doneBits &= (allBits ^ prevC1)
                    cost = dp[prevC0][prevC1] + n - bin(doneBits).count('1')
                    if cost < newDp[prevC1][c2]:
                        newDp[prevC1][c2] = cost
    dp = newDp
minVal = min(min(row) for row in dp)
print(n * m - minVal)
